actions_or_findings.title: CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: Reconcile the frozen phone-uniqueness rule
actions_or_findings.trigger: The report recommends retaining active-only phone constraints, while the formal model also says unique(phone_e164) without an active-only qualifier.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The recommendation to keep one ACTIVE phone per user is supported by the current scalar flows. The audit must still resolve whether an ENDED number may ever be rebound and how merged-source numbers remain blocked from SMS auto-registration.

actions_or_findings.title: CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: Specify an implementable source-proof path
actions_or_findings.trigger: The proposed source OTP must bind source, target, purpose and expiry, but 0009 has no merge SMS purpose or source-target binding. The report’s own counts also include an ACTIVE user without an ACTIVE phone.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The revised 0010 design must identify where the proof, attempt limits and one-use state live, and define a safe route for a phone-free source. The stated ledger and existing challenge flow do not yet establish this.

actions_or_findings.title: CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: Separate bind-request ownership from applicant history
actions_or_findings.trigger: The report moves every resident_bind_requests.user_id, including reviewed requests.
actions_or_findings.rationale: That column identifies both the current list owner and the person who originally applied. Reparenting a completed request changes its recorded applicant. Specify treatment of PENDING versus APPROVED/REJECTED rows, preserving original attribution and target access.

actions_or_findings.title: CURRENT_TASK_BLOCKER: Resolve source-password disposition
actions_or_findings.trigger: The report offers transfer of the source password hash when the target has no password.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The frozen requirement does not choose that authentication policy. The owner must choose transfer or a new target password before this branch enters an approved merge design.

actions_or_findings.title: NON_BLOCKING: Preserve the limits of saved environment evidence
actions_or_findings.trigger: The saved JUnit files contain 407 and 7 passing cases, but the listed live database counts, process state and one-warning claims have no separate raw capture in this audit directory.
actions_or_findings.rationale: The counts in JUnit are verified from the files; the other observations remain report-derived. Preserve that provenance boundary when requesting migration approval.
